scope: Read-only geometry/pair counting and arithmetic storage estimate; no travel times, observations, or inverse models generated
selection: All unordered event pairs with Euclidean 3-D distance strictly below 20 km; every selected receiver is used by the existing synthetic generator

csv.interpretation: All index/identifier/epoch/label/separator bytes are counted analytically; value-field lengths remain unknown before ray/noise generation

memory.interpretation: 64-bit libstdc++ lower bounds include actual repeated identity strings and metadata keys, 32-entry metadata vector capacity, and simultaneous raw CSV table plus Datum storage. Exclude allocator overhead, outer vector spare capacity, numeric-string heaps, rays, matrix/LSQR work, residuals, and other output. Not a peak RSS measurement.
memory.matrix_scenario_interpretation: Assumes every row remains active; listed average entries per row are scenarios only, excluding row objects/capacity/allocator and solver copies

compression_interpretation: Measured existing-file ratios are analogues, not predictions for the ungenerated Loma data. Lossless gzip preserves selection but current C++ input requires plain CSV and still materializes all rows.
